gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.0: The Void Ore Miner will produce tons of ores.
gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.1: It will consume Pyrotheum and Cryotheum alternating each second.
gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.2: Temperature will increase if there is only Pyrotheum and will decrease if there is only Cryotheum.
gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.3: The First step will be to only feed with Pyrotheum and when the temperature is at the perfect spot, slowly add Cryotheum.
gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.4: If temperature is above the max temperature the Void Ore Miner will stop working and slowly cool down.
gregicality.machine.void_miner.tooltip.5: Consumes Drilling Mud and outputs Used Drilling Mud every second at the same rate as Pyrotheum.
